title: Xinye Is Burned and Abandoned; Cao Cao Comes South
summary: Liu Biao dies. His younger son surrenders Jing province by letter without telling anyone, and is rewarded with a governorship far away and murdered on the road to it.
Zhuge Liang burns Xinye behind them and Liu Bei goes south — with a hundred thousand civilians who will not stay behind, moving at ten li a day, with Cao Cao's cavalry coming on at three hundred.
history: The surrender of Jing and the flight south are historical. So, remarkably, is the crowd: Liu Bei really did refuse to abandon the people who followed him, and it nearly killed him.

pins.note: Surrenders the province by letter, and is killed for it.
Takes Jing province without a battle.
Burns the town and moves at ten li a day.
Holds Jiangxia, and a way out.
